title: Gaps in window counts after every consumer restart
scenario: The vibration dashboard has holes in 2026-10-20 for every pump, at different hours, after two OOM kills and a deploy of the Kafka sink. Kafka logged an under-replicated partition that morning and lag warnings all day. The plant is about to train a model on this table.
task: Find the root cause of the missing windows and prove it from the incident logs
Explain why the holes sit at different hours per pump; rule out the red herrings
Fix the sink so restarts at any point lose and duplicate nothing, with writes still batched
Plan the recovery of the lost windows
acceptance: Replay with restarts stores exactly 8640 distinct windows and 8640 rows
Kill after write or before write: still 8640 / 8640; offsets never ahead of durable rows
ANSWER.md: root cause with log evidence, red herrings, recovery plan

practices.label: Week 1 Tue - Kafka consumer groups, offsets and auto-commit
Week 1 Wed - at-least-once plus idempotent writes
